nodes.title: ElastiCache cluster has no AUTH token configured
nodes.description: The ElastiCache Redis cluster 'ecommerce-cache' does not require an AUTH token. Any client reaching port 6379 has unrestricted access to all cached data.

control.name: ElastiCache Redis clusters should require AUTH tokens

nodes.title: Security group allows unrestricted inbound access to Redis port 6379
nodes.description: Security group 'ecommerce-cache' permits inbound TCP from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 6379.

control.name: Security groups should not permit unrestricted access to sensitive ports

nodes.title: ECS task definition does not specify a non-root user
nodes.description: The ECS task definition 'ecommerce-api:9' runs container processes as root (UID 0).

control.name: ECS task definitions should specify a non-root user

nodes.title: ECS task IAM role grants overly broad S3 permissions
nodes.description: IAM role 'ecommerce-task-role' grants s3:* on * — exceeds minimum required permissions.

control.name: IAM policies should follow the principle of least privilege

nodes.title: Container image contains known high-severity vulnerable dependency (CVE-2022-39353)
nodes.description: Container image scan of the ECS task definition 'ecommerce-api:9' detected the npm package xmldom@0.1.31 in the container filesystem. This version is affected by CVE-2022-39353 (XXE injection, CVSS 7.5). The package is present both as a direct dependency (added in the latest build) and transitively via passport-twitter → passport-oauth1.

control.name: Container images should not include packages with known critical or high vulnerabilities
control.description: Container image scanning detected a known-vulnerable package. Remediate before deploying to production.

nodes.title: Secret value detected in ECS task definition environment variable
nodes.description: The ECS task definition 'ecommerce-api:9' contains an environment variable whose value matches a pattern consistent with a JWT secret or similar credential. The variable 'ACCESS_TOKEN_FALLBACK' contains a string value that appears to be a hardcoded secret. Secrets should be referenced from AWS Secrets Manager rather than stored as plaintext values.

control.name: ECS task definitions should not contain hardcoded secrets
control.description: Secret values in plaintext environment variables are exposed in the ECS task definition and CloudTrail API logs.
